map.化工产品纯度计算与质量判定 使用指南: Chemical Product Purity Calculation and Quality Judgement User Guide
map.支持酸碱滴定法和重量法计算化学品纯度，输入实验数据自动计算纯度百分比，并对照标准: Supports acid-base titration and gravimetric purity calculation for chemicals; enter the experimental data and the purity percentage is computed automatically and checked against the standard threshold.
map.滴定法纯度计算：按标准溶液浓度、消耗体积与计量比算待测物纯度。: Titration purity calculation: compute the analyte purity from the standard solution concentration, consumed volume and stoichiometric ratio.
map.重量法纯度核算：由称量形式质量换算待测组分质量分数。: Gravimetric purity calculation: convert the weighed sample mass into the mass fraction of the analyte.
map.出厂合格判定：对照产品标准纯度阈值，给出合格/不合格结论与偏离量。: Factory release judgement: compare purity against the product standard threshold to give a pass/fail conclusion and the deviation.
map.：输入标准液浓度 0.1mol/L、消耗 25.0mL、计量比 1:1、样品 0: : enter standard solution 0.1mol/L, consumed 25.0mL, ratio 1:1, sample 0.5000g; the tool outputs purity around 50.0% (by equivalent conversion) and checks it against the threshold.
map.滴定法和重量法哪个更准？: Which is more accurate, titration or gravimetry?
map.各有适用：滴定法快速、适合常量；重量法精度高但耗时。以产品标准规定的方法为准，争: Each has its place: titration is fast and suits routine work; gravimetry is more accurate but slower. Follow the method specified by the product standard, and use the arbitration method in disputes.
map.纯度不达标怎么查因？: How to investigate when purity falls short?
map.检查滴定终点判定、试剂浓度标定、样品称量与干扰离子；逐项复核避免系统偏差。: Check the titration endpoint determination, reagent standardisation, sample weighing and interfering ions; review item by item to avoid systematic bias.
map.阈值从哪里来？: Where do the thresholds come from?
map.来自产品企业标准或国标/行标（如 GB/T 系列）；本工具仅作计算对照，合格判定: Taken from the manufacturer's enterprise standard or national/industry standards (e.g. the GB/T series); this tool is for calculation comparison only, and conformance is judged against the formal standard.
